pageStyle() has the exact same callee pair (pageCssFor + fontFaceCssForArtifacts) as docgenPageStyle() in src/docgen/render/shell.ts. The Story's stated goal is a *shared* theme policy across the companion and docgen shells, but the page-style composition itself was re-written per-shell instead of being lifted into one shared helper (e.g. in src/artifact-theme/theme.ts) that both renderCompanionPage and buildHtml call. This is exactly the kind of drift that produced the prior 'wire legendHtml + exportableSvg into both shells' fix — the next time pageCssFor's output changes, one of the two copies is likely to be missed.

assembleFallbackShell(ir, svg, svgPanZoom, svgPanZoomVersion) calls pageCssFor and fontFaceCssForArtifacts directly rather than going through docgenPageStyle (used by the primary buildHtml path) or pageStyle (used by the companion path). Because assembleFallbackShell takes no ThemeMode parameter, it is calling pageCssFor with a single hardcoded mode rather than composing both the light and dark variants the way docgenPageStyle does — so the Graphviz degraded-fallback shell risks rendering without the light/dark theme switch that this Story exists to guarantee, while the primary mermaid shell gets it correctly.
